com.vector.cfg.dom.runtimesys.groovy.api

Interface IOriginComponentPortSelection


  • @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public interface IOriginComponentPortSelection
    IOriginComponentPortSelection represents a selection of IOriginComponentPorts which can be used as additional information for other operations. The origin component ports selected here are ends of incomplete delegation connections of the structured extract.

    • Method Detail

      • createFlatExtractDelegationPorts

        @PublishedMethod
java.util.List<IComponentPort> createFlatExtractDelegationPorts(@Nonnull @VDelegatesToWithClosureParam(value=IDelegationPortCreator.class)
                                                                                  groovy.lang.Closure<?> createPortCode)

        createFlatExtractDelegationPorts(Closure) creates a PortPrototype on the ecu composition of the FlatExtract for each selected origin component port using their port interfaces. If the naming is not specified, the names of the created delegation ports are derived from the port interfaces. The direction of the ports has to be specified.

        The origin component port selection will produce trace, info and warning logs. To see them, activate the 'com.vector.cfg.dom.runtimesys.groovy.api.IOriginComponentPortSelection' logger with the appropriate log level.

        Returns:
        A list of the newly created delegation component ports in the flat extract.

      • getOriginComponentPorts

        @PublishedMethod
java.util.Collection<IOriginComponentPort> getOriginComponentPorts()
        getOriginComponentPorts() allows access to the single origin component ports in the IOriginComponentPortSelection.
        Returns:
        The collection of selected origin component ports.
